ov: Small nocturnal primates of sub-Saharan Africa, also called galagos, with big eyes for night vision, sharp hearing, and bat-like ears they fold back in thick bushes. Long tails help them balance. They catch insects on the ground or snatch them out of the air, and are remarkable jumpers.

why.ac: Small nocturnal primates; the Afrikaans name nagapie means "night monkey".

df: Insects and other small animals, fruit and tree gum.
fx: The highest reliably reported galago jump is 2.25 m.
They mark their paths with urine, which helps them land on exactly the same branch every time.
